item.title: [LOW] GHSA: swagger-typescript-api vulnerable to authorization-token exfiltration via spec `$ref`
item.description: ### Summary When the developer supplies an `--authorizationToken` (commonly required to fetch a private spec behind authentication), `swagger-typescript-api` attaches that token to the `Authorization` header of **every** subsequent HTTP request it makes while resolving external `$ref` URLs in the spec — with **no same-origin check, no host allowlist, and no scope-down** for cross-origin requests.
